title: GPS Spoof — Bus 107 on Route 14

lines.text: Dispatch, Driver 107 on Route 14. Bus 107 is stopped at the stop on 4th and Maple. The GPS tracker shows the bus at the north edge of the city, but we’re at the stop and the doors won’t open. The SIS is showing a student on board who isn’t there. Can you check?
Driver 107, standby. We’re checking the Transfinder feed and SIS status. Do not open the doors. Remain at the stop until further instruction.

fields.voiceStyle: Young male, tense, voice shaking slightly

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging. The Transportation Branch Director must confirm the GPS feed is spoofed and the SIS is corrupted.
